text: QTerminals is a terminal operating company jointly established by Qatar Ports Management Company (Mwani Qatar, 51 percent shareholding) and Qatar Navigation (Milaha, 49 percent shareholding). Mwani Qatar is the Qatari state's ports company, so a Qatari state body holds the majority of QTerminals. A state shareholding alone is not a rating.
short: QTerminals: 51% Mwani Qatar (state ports company), 49% Milaha.
